publisher: New Jersey Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services
reassessment_reason: Pin the current July 2026 fee schedule and 2023 readoption; distinguish listed bulk selectors and capacity qualifications from a complete statewide machine feed.

access.bulk: Bulk Access Status Reports line item 01000000 remains listed. Filing date and entity type are the published selectors; an active-only or ZIP selector is not established.
access.api: No supported public business-entity bulk API contract was established.
access.fees: $0.0185 per record; final volume, media and payment charges require a quote. Listed delivery media include FTP, email, magnetic disk and paper, subject to capacity.

fields.summary: The schedule lists business names, legal status, registered-agent/office, annual-report dates, business addresses and associated names. This is an informational inventory, not a machine schema; identifier lifecycle, widths, types and missing-value rules remain unresolved.

active_status_semantics: Legal status in the status report does not establish an operating business or physical establishment. No complete bulk status codebook or active subset was verified.
statewide_completeness: A quote for a selected registry population does not establish all operating businesses or complete geographic coverage; statewide_complete=false.
address_zip: Business-address roles need a bulk dictionary. Registered office is separate from an operating location. Preserve ZIP5 and ZIP4 in separate fields.
automation_terms_fees: The 2023 notice readopts N.J.A.C. 17:34 through June 27, 2030. Historical published procedures describe quotes, authorization and payment before production; FTP being listed is not a supported unattended retrieval contract.
redistribution: The portal disclaimer is not an affirmative paid-extract retention or redistribution grant; scope for derived outputs remains unresolved.
temporal_refresh: Published historical procedure permits ongoing updates, but cadence, baseline, deletion, correction, replay and checksum contracts remain unverified.

citations.evidence: Current page dated July 1, 2026 confirms price, selectors, content inventory and capacity caveat.
2023 readoption states effective June 27, 2023 and expiration June 27, 2030.
Historical proposed amendments describe 500-record threshold, quote and payment workflow; not a current machine-delivery specification.
Portal disclaimer reviewed; no paid-extract license established.

strongest_next_action: Obtain the schema-only specification for line item 01000000, exact type/status selection and address roles, and supported delivery/change/use terms before ordering. Reconfirm current request procedure rather than treating the historical proposal as an executed agreement. This assessment authorizes no contact or order.
